newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss October inflation rises to 0.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss October inflation rises to 0.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices rose 0.2 percent in October from the previous month for a year-on-year inflation rate of 0.8 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change +0.2 pct +0.1 pct -0.1 pct
The price index in October was due mainly to higher prices for heating oil, which rose by 20.4 percent as compared to the previous month, the statistics office said in its statement.

It said prices in the index group Rents and Energy rose by 0.7 percent and the Healthcare index component rose by 0.1 percent while the the sub-indices Foodstuffs, Beverages and Tobacco declined by 0.1 percent. The Transportation and Communication sub-index also fell by 0.1 percent.
There were no price increases recorded in the other four sub-indices, the statement also said. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
